correctness.rationale: The balanced two-site specialization is correct. Symmetry forces each scaling vector to remain a scalar multiple of the all-ones vector, so at effective temperature \(\varepsilon=\eta/p\) the scaled Gibbs kernel is exactly \(Z=[2(1+z)]^{-1}\begin{psmallmatrix}1&z\\z&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), with \(z=e^{-p\Delta/\eta}\), and it already has both target marginals. The primal cost is therefore \(U=\Delta z/(1+z)\). Substitution into the source dual certificate cancels the arbitrary scalar scaling and gives \(L=-(\eta/p)\log(1+z)\). The displayed derivative of \(G=U-L\) has three strictly negative terms, so the stopping-index ceiling formulas and the asymptotic ratio follow. The actual package verifier at blob 4b561642645ad69448db32e1d2d7b5119cd4b34f was inspected and independently reconstructs the same scalar equations; its numerical checks are supplementary to the analytic proof.
